discovery.source_boundary: $COLLAB/.tmp/skills-main is intake evidence only; MorroWise registry/schema/verifier/read model are durable source of truth.

allowed: generate a read-only workflow catalog read model
route next action to MorroWise owner task or verifier
record adapter_only status for external tracker semantics
forbidden: read secrets, tokens, cookies, or runtime auth files
write GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, Notion, Heptabase, or external trackers

workflows.trigger: User or agent is unsure which development workflow fits.
workflows.inputs: Situation, existing task/spec context, current repo state.
workflows.process: Classify the situation into main flow, triage on-ramp, bug diagnosis, codebase health, vocabulary, or standalone workflow.
workflows.outputs: Recommended route and next workflow id.
workflows.approval_policy: No approval needed for read-only routing; approval required before any external adapter write.
workflows.close_rule: Close when a downstream workflow owner_task is selected or a no-op reason is recorded.
workflows.notes: Router pattern only; it does not perform development work.

workflows.trigger: A plan feels plausible but has hidden unresolved decisions.
workflows.inputs: Draft plan, user intent, current constraints.
workflows.process: Run a one-question-at-a-time stress test over the decision tree.
workflows.outputs: Sharper shared understanding in the current conversation.
workflows.approval_policy: No external approval; cannot close MorroWise task without durable follow-up evidence.
workflows.close_rule: Close only by handing the sharpened decision into a durable workflow such as grill-with-docs, to-prd, or task note.
workflows.notes: Accepted as pre-workflow; not a formal MorroWise start because it is stateless.

workflows.trigger: A change needs shared language, decisions, and durable alignment before implementation.
workflows.process: Interview one decision at a time and capture resolved terms and hard decisions.
workflows.outputs: Durable vocabulary and decision notes suitable for PRD or task update.
workflows.writes_to: MorroWise docs or task notes selected by the active owner task
workflows.approval_policy: Allowed only inside the active work anchor; new durable docs need normal repo edit review.
workflows.close_rule: Close when resolved terms and decisions are referenced by the downstream PRD/task/spec.
workflows.notes: Formal start pattern because it leaves durable artifacts.

workflows.trigger: Domain terms are overloaded, fuzzy, or conflict with code/task state.
workflows.process: Challenge terms with concrete scenarios and record stable language or decisions.
workflows.outputs: Glossary-level language and ADR/task-note decision references.
workflows.writes_to: approved glossary, ADR, task note, or registry detail doc
workflows.approval_policy: Use active task approval for durable docs; no external writes.
workflows.close_rule: Close when the chosen term/decision is referenced by the owner spec or task.
workflows.notes: Runs underneath planning and review workflows.

workflows.trigger: Conversation and context are settled and need a durable implementation spec.
workflows.inputs: Resolved conversation, domain language, implementation decisions, test seams.
workflows.process: Synthesize known context into PRD without a fresh interview.
workflows.outputs: PRD/spec artifact with problem, solution, stories, decisions, testing, and out-of-scope.
workflows.writes_to: MorroWise spec/doc path or task note
workflows.approval_policy: External publication requires separate adapter approval; local docs follow normal repo review.
workflows.close_rule: Close when the PRD/spec path is linked from the owner task and has test seams.
workflows.notes: MorroWise version writes local durable specs, not external trackers by default.

workflows.trigger: A PRD/spec needs independently grabbable implementation slices.
workflows.process: Split work into dependency-ordered tracer bullets.
workflows.outputs: Issue/task breakdown with blockers and acceptance notes.
workflows.writes_to: tasks.json or approved local task registry; github_issues only through future adapter
workflows.approval_policy: GitHub/GitLab issue publication is adapter_only and requires explicit approval policy.
workflows.close_rule: Close when slices are recorded in MorroWise task state or an approved adapter handoff.
workflows.notes: External issue tracker semantics are useful, but MorroWise canonical state remains tasks.json.

workflows.trigger: A spec or task slice is ready to build.
workflows.inputs: Owner task, spec/issue, test seams, acceptance conditions.
workflows.process: Build one slice through TDD, run focused checks, then full verification.
workflows.outputs: Implementation diff, verifier output, review handoff, task evidence.
workflows.writes_to: repo files under active work anchor
workflows.approval_policy: Commit/push still follows worktree-commit and Vincent approval gates.
workflows.close_rule: Close when acceptance evidence, tests, and task-state update are recorded.
workflows.notes: Execution pattern; does not bypass local repo commit policy.

workflows.trigger: A concrete behavior needs implementation or bugfix.
workflows.inputs: Pre-agreed seam, expected behavior, failure mode.
workflows.process: Run red-green loop with one behavior at a time.
workflows.writes_to: test and implementation files under active work anchor
workflows.approval_policy: No external approval for local tests; commit still requires worktree-commit.
workflows.close_rule: Close when red and green evidence are both recorded or cited.
workflows.notes: Useful as standalone or inside implement.

workflows.trigger: A diff or branch needs standards/spec review before closeout.
workflows.inputs: Fixed point, diff, spec source, repo standards.
workflows.process: Review against standards and originating spec.
workflows.approval_policy: External PR comments require separate adapter approval.
workflows.close_rule: Close when findings are addressed or explicitly accepted as residual risk.
workflows.notes: Review output is evidence, not automatic merge permission.

workflows.trigger: A bug, regression, flake, or unexpected behavior needs root cause.
workflows.process: Build a tight red-capable feedback loop before hypothesizing.
workflows.outputs: Repro command, ranked diagnosis, fix path, regression evidence.
workflows.writes_to: tests, notes, or implementation files under active work anchor
workflows.approval_policy: Production instrumentation or external environment access needs explicit approval.
workflows.close_rule: Close when the reproduction loop goes green and residual risks are recorded.
workflows.notes: Complements TDD by demanding a red-capable command first.

workflows.trigger: A fact, API behavior, or source claim needs primary-source evidence.
workflows.inputs: Research question, accepted source classes, target doc path.
workflows.process: Read primary sources and capture cited findings.
workflows.writes_to: approved research doc under active work anchor
workflows.approval_policy: Network or external source access follows current tool approval rules.
workflows.close_rule: Close when cited artifact is linked from the owner task/spec.
workflows.notes: Useful upstream of planning; not a substitute for task state.

workflows.trigger: A state model, logic idea, or UI direction needs a disposable answer.
workflows.inputs: One question to answer and expected throwaway boundary.
workflows.process: Build a clearly disposable prototype and capture the answer.
workflows.writes_to: temporary prototype path plus durable verdict note
workflows.approval_policy: Prototype code cannot become production without a follow-up implementation task.
workflows.close_rule: Close when the answer is captured and prototype is deleted or absorbed through a real task.
workflows.notes: Kept as prototype status to prevent accidental production claims.

workflows.trigger: Codebase health needs periodic deep-module/deepening review.
workflows.inputs: Repo context, glossary/ADR references, changed architecture area.
workflows.process: Find deepening opportunities and turn chosen item into a workflow candidate.
workflows.outputs: Architecture opportunity report and chosen next task/spec.
workflows.approval_policy: Generated reports are evidence only; structural refactors need separate owner task.
workflows.close_rule: Close when selected opportunity becomes a MorroWise task or is explicitly declined.
workflows.notes: Survey workflow, not a direct refactor command.

workflows.trigger: Incoming bugs, requests, or PRs need categorization and readiness evaluation.
workflows.inputs: Incoming report/PR, tracker state, repro or context.
workflows.process: Classify category/state, verify claims, and prepare agent-ready brief.
workflows.outputs: Triage recommendation, brief, or tasks.json candidate.
workflows.writes_to: tasks.json or approved local triage note; external tracker only through future adapter
workflows.approval_policy: External labels/comments require explicit adapter approval.
workflows.close_rule: Close when request is recorded in MorroWise canonical task state or declined with reason.
workflows.notes: External tracker workflow is useful but cannot own MorroWise state.

workflows.trigger: A merge or rebase is already in conflict.
workflows.inputs: Current merge/rebase state, commit intent, conflict hunks.
workflows.process: Resolve by intent, preserve compatible changes, run checks, finish merge/rebase.
workflows.writes_to: repo files under explicit merge/rebase owner task
workflows.approval_policy: Deferred until MorroWise has a merge-operation owner and non-destructive policy.
workflows.close_rule: Close when a future owner task defines merge state, checks, and allowed operations.
workflows.notes: Deferred because destructive merge/rebase boundaries need a separate task.
